segments.text: ALmightye God, whiche in the place of the traytor Iudas, didſt choſe thy faythfull ſeruaunte Mathie, to bee of the noumber of thy twelue Apoſtles: Graunte that thy church being alway preſerued from falſe Apoſtles, may be ordred and guided by faythfull and true paſtors: Through Ieſus Chriſt our Lorde.
